problem: Audit per-action editor particles, shake, flash and glow for bounded work and responsiveness.
changes: Analytic particle motion stays in GPU shaders; instanced quads share four vertices instead of six, with a hard 256-particle / 1024-vertex / 8192-byte instance budget.
Resident animation updates only the time uniform; viewport, accent and appearance uniforms invalidate independently. Unchanged instance batches are reused.
CPU-only feedback and all-Off actions avoid initializing particle rendering. Live effects retain their renderer; input capture and shake preparation have disabled fast paths.
Glow reuses immutable ring directions and triangle indices, with exact-sized frame buffers; no per-frame trigonometry.
Full-document diff layout no longer invalidates twice per repaint due to inconsistent spacing. Changed backgrounds and line numbers only visit visible rows plus four points of overscan.
Retained diff galleys invalidate after font-atlas recreation even when font metrics and settings are unchanged. Invalid/collapsed clips are safe, and live shake survives preference changes.

thread_ownership.gpu: Particle positions, drag, gravity, rotation, age and style drawing are evaluated analytically by GPU shaders. There is no CPU particle simulation worker or simulation loop.
thread_ownership.ui_and_graphics_owner: Input admission, bounded state/expiry checks, tiny shake/flash/glow paint updates and GL command submission remain on the egui/current-GL-context owner. Moving egui paint data or its current GL context to an arbitrary worker would require copies or synchronization and is not justified by the measured microsecond cost.
thread_ownership.idle: Finite feedback expiry stops repaint requests; default effects remain disabled. No per-frame disk I/O or production profiling counters were added.

cpu_effects.included: Marker begin/finish and production editor_particles::paint CPU work; test observation bookkeeping is equal before/after.
cpu_effects.caveat: 120 Hz is a logical clock, not measured FPS. Forty-nanosecond differences such as Shake are near one timer tick; no every-case improvement is claimed. Headless idle still exercises callback preparation, not a ready native steady-idle backend.

cached_diff_paint.included: Actual cached full_view::show painting and widgets, including diff layout cache lookup.

gpu_resident_batches.included: CPU GL submission and inclusive completion wall time (submission through final gl.finish), separately recorded. Completion is not isolated GPU time and must not be added to submission.
gpu_resident_batches.supplemental_method: Three additional alternating GPU-only pairs. The identical complete baseline GPU probe runs immediately before each target invocation. Original primary results remain unchanged.
gpu_resident_batches.interpretation: Submission medians improve in all primary cases. Nine primary completion cases improve, but light Explosion regresses 18.444 to 21.017 ms per 2000 draws. Additional equal external warmup reverses that case (24.923 to 21.403 ms), consistent with start/context variance (inferred, not isolated). No universal GPU/FPS improvement is claimed. The four-vertex budget and one resident uniform write are deterministic.

verification.pixel_scope: Private CGL/egui framebuffers; no native child-view or whole-desktop composition claim.
